raw_response: {"diagnosis":"All 377 rows with source_tz='UTC' are batch 13, and their txn_ts is in UTC while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time. Batch 13 starts at 12:00 (06:00 Chicago), and its evening transactions spill past midnight into 2026-01-18 00:00-05:00, which causes the off-hours alert and wrong txn_date values. Converting the UTC rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6, no DST in January) fixes txn_ts and txn_date, and the gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
